display_long_description:
# The closest thing to real sparring in VR

Fight ultra-realistic AI opponents that bob, weave, feint, and hit back.

They read your movement and punish a lazy guard.

It's a real workout that leaves you dripping, whether it's your first round or you box for real. 

[media]

What boxers say:

- "I'm a boxer and this is the closest to real fighting/sparring that you can get." – endcole
- "The crown jewel of this game is the AI movement: bobbing, weaving…" – oculusboxfox
- "Feints being registered/reacted to is an insane game changer." – alealejandro73
- "The fighters actually move like real boxers. Great workout." – docproc.2024


🧠 Smart, lifelike AI

Advanced dodging and lifelike animation. Every fighter reads your movement and punishes a lazy guard — no two move the same.

💦 A workout that leaves you dripping

First round or seasoned boxer, you set the pace and the intensity.

🏠 VR or mixed reality

Fight in a full VR ring or in mixed reality, right in your own room — your real space, your real footwork.

🔓 Early Access

Lock in the early adopter price — the lowest it'll ever be — and grow with the game.

💬 Join the community: https://ultraboxingvr.com/discord

Note: UltraBoxing is built around realism. If you want thumbstick movement and in-game stamina like Creed, this may not be your game.
